name: Editor Advanced Table
description: Adds ID, Language Direction, and CSS classes to CKEditor 5 tables.
project_description: Inspired by Editor Advanced Link, this module enhances the Table Properties experience in CKEditor 5 by letting editors set extra HTML attributes on tables: a CSS class list, an id, and a text-direction (dir) value. It recreates the CKEditor 4 "Advanced" tab for tables. It ships a single CKEditor 5 plugin (machine id editor_advanced_table_table_advanced) that adds a toolbar button and a balloon form to the table content toolbar. Which of the three attributes are offered to editors is configurable per text format on the CKEditor 5 plugin settings tab. Requires Drupal 10 or 11 and PHP 8.1+, and depends only on core's ckeditor5 module.
